svg.text: Northwind Order Advisor on SAP BTP
Client → BTP authentication → agent on BTP → RAG on BTP, in HANA Cloud
SAP AI Core. On a trial account:
Role collections: who may see what · Destination service: keys kept out of code · Audit trail: who asked, what was retrieved, which tool ran (a HANA table on trial)
Get live order and stock facts,
Answer with sources and data time
The client talks only to the agent.
It never reaches the documents, the database or the model directly.
Access is decided where the data lives.
The policy server filters documents by audience; the CAP service filters rows by user.
Claude explains; it does not act.
Read-only tools, no approvals, and every answer cites its policy source.
